## Streaming bitrate

- Streaming now uses a 5000 kbit/s H.264 max-rate baseline at every output tier. HEVC, Main10, and AV1 rates continue to use the codec multipliers from `config.ini`; buffer size follows the final max rate.

## Music Video encoding

- Music Video now follows Streaming's video quality settings while keeping music-video audio and Auto Scale behavior.
- Music Video defaults to HEVC Main10 when supported, with spatial AQ 6, B-frames disabled, and NVENC P6.
